decision.title: No C recursion
decision.summary: Project code never recurses, directly, across files or through function pointers; every walk over nested structure is a loop over an explicit stack in allocator memory, checked by clang-tidy and tools/check-call-cycles.py.

body.p: at the owner's request ("make sure we don't use C recursion"). Project code never recurses: not directly, not through a chain of functions, not through function pointers or operations tables. Every walk over nested structure (CST, AST, IR, types, regex patterns, maps, arrays, trees, JNodes, sequences) is a loop over an explicit stack or work list in allocator memory, bounded by a configured limit that reports LIMIT_EXCEEDED (or the specification's error). Consequences:

item.p: clang-tidy misc-no-recursion is on (.clang-tidy); it sees recursion within one file. Review checks recursion across files and through pointers.

The evaluator is an explicit-stack machine. Calling a function item from a native function (for example fn:for-each, fn:sort with a key, fn:fold-left) must not re-enter the evaluator on the C stack: native higher-order functions are written as resumable steps that ask the evaluator to make the call and resume them with the result. The same holds for lazy sequence generators that evaluate IR. Packets and follow this.
Limits such as maximum_expression_depth bound heap use, not C stack, so their defaults no longer depend on the WebAssembly stack size (this replaces the 32-level lowering depth of ).
Existing recursive code is rewritten: xpath_lower.c, xpath_static.c, ir.c, types.c, cast.c, regex.c, xdm_map.c, xdm_array.c, xdm_atomic.c and two tests.
Vendored third-party code (tree-sitter, libmpdec) is exempt; the generated grammar scanners are ours and have no recursion.

tools/check-call-cycles.py (run by tools/lint.sh) links all of src/ and apps/ into one LLVM module and fails on any call-graph cycle, so recursion across files is caught too (not through function pointers). tools/call-cycles-allowlist.txt lists the cycles still being rewritten; it is temporary: each rewrite deletes its lines (a stale entry fails the check) until the file is empty and the allowlist is removed.

Lowering (src/xpath_lower.c), type resolution (src/xpath_static.c) and the type text of src/ir.c are rewritten: lowering is a machine of frames allocated one by one (a procedure, a step, locals; results written into the frame below), type resolution and type text use stacks of at most 64 frames (SXML_XPATH_MAXIMUM_TYPE_DEPTH, the text's depth limit). Free-variable analysis skips AST subtrees without variable references, so nested inline functions cost linear time. 100,000 levels of parentheses, calls, inline functions and predicates compile, also on wasm. misc-no-recursion is on and the call-cycle allowlist is empty.

sources.source: 100,000 levels of parentheses, calls, inline functions and predicates compile, natively and on wasm
